items.text: Medical imaging and radiography technology careers involve operating X-ray, CT, MRI and related equipment, positioning patients, following radiation safety rules and supporting radiologists with clear images, and they require recognised training, careful safety habits and good patient communication.
Check the official bodies and course recognition before enrolling.
